externalAgentPolicy.description: External AI agents operate strictly as read-only auditors and advisors. They inspect exported Playbooks, Toolbox manifests, Proof Reports, and 6-Point Audit Bundles, but cannot execute direct code or parameter changes.

turns.questionText: How should Playbooks and the Toolbox Store be persisted and shared across Google AI Studio and external AI agents?
turns.operatorAnswer: All 3 options combined; external agents are strictly for external audit and advisory purposes and cannot execute any change.
turns.resolvedConstraint: Dual-Layer Persistence (Markdown files on disk + TypeScript API/JSON store + Read-Only External Auditor Packet export).

turns.questionText: How strictly should stage gates and the promotion gate (Rule 8) be enforced?
turns.operatorAnswer: Option 3 / 3a — Hard Stage-Gate Enforcement + Dual-Control Promotion Gate for both internal and external audits.
turns.resolvedConstraint: Automated candidate promotion requires both quantitative OOS gate pass and a verified PASS Proof Report.

turns.questionText: How should Audit Mode and Step 5 Loopback operate?
turns.operatorAnswer: Option B — On-Demand Audit Center with Automatic Loopback version upgrades.
turns.resolvedConstraint: Triggered on demand via /api/gdf-os/audit; automatically increments playbook versions (v1.0 -> v1.1) when faults or unverified claims are found.

turns.questionText: What baseline scope of Playbooks and Toolbox assets should be seeded initially?
turns.operatorAnswer: Option B — Full GDF Baseline Seeding (PB-001 through PB-006 + complete Toolbox Store index).
turns.resolvedConstraint: Seed PB-001..PB-006 and TB-001..TB-012 covering the entire GDF architecture.

turns.questionText: How should Proof verification be executed and exposed in the Operator MMI?
turns.operatorAnswer: Option A2 — Live Backend Proof Runner + Non-Intrusive Header Drawer in index.html.
turns.resolvedConstraint: Live backend proof execution (/api/gdf-os/run-proof) paired with a slide-over header drawer in index.html.
